purpose: warm-cache prefill and decode throughput, one request at a time
protocol: Load the model once and keep the process alive for the whole suite.
Send every warmup request in file order at the suite TG; do not score them.
In the same process, send the measurement requests in file order at the suite TG.
One request at a time, greedy, speculation off, approximate skips off.
Zero cross-request prefix/KV reuse; ordinary KV caching inside one generation stays.
Do not reload the model, clear its caches or change placement settings between phases.
Keep incomplete requests; a natural EOS before the TG budget is not a completed sample.
Baseline: approximate prompt skips off, dense and expert precision unmodified.
notes: The 12 warmups are identical to project-maya/ds41-pr592 (same pool, seed and PP).
Sources are frozen Russian Wikipedia prose: page id, revision, URL and SHA-256 per article.
The dev pool was used by earlier Maya tuning; this is a baseline corpus, not a blind holdout.
The holdout article list here is intentionally not part of sources.jsonl.
PP is the complete tokenised input; only source prose is cut to reach it.
TG256 is a request parameter, not part of the frozen files.
README.md is documentation; it is not covered by the file hashes in the manifest.
